section_note: THE SECTION FIELD SAYS 'Wall units H. 120' AND THE PAGE IS HEADED 'Dish-drainer units H. 120'. That is deliberate. The wall chapter index on printed p.205 jumps 252 to 255 and never names a dish-drainer section at this height, though it names one at every other height. Learned rule 1 says a SECTION is what the printed index prints, so printed p.254 is mapped as a PAGE of the section whose range contains it - exactly as printed p.435 is mapped inside the filler section. The file is still named for what it holds, and the type keys still say dish_drainer_. THE INDEX UNDER-PRINTS TWICE IN THIS BOOK, in two independent chapters, which makes it a pattern and not an accident.
extraction_note: Three of four positions, 9 of 10 codes. The fourth is the 90-degree corner dish-drainer OJ0734, 75x75 only - the fifth family to print exactly one size there, and the first to give it suffix 34 instead of 45. Elda Q7b.

dish_drainer_top_hung_doors_stacked.notes: THE HEADING AND THE DESCRIPTION DISAGREE ON THIS POSITION AND BOTH ARE KEPT. It is headed 'Dish-drainer unit with door' - singular, the heading of the FIRST position on the page - while its own first line reads '2 top-hung door'. The elevation settles it: 60 + 60, two leaves, and the drawing shows two. It also prints '155 degree hinges' on a top-hung pair, where every other family's stacked position prints the Push-pull device instead and no hinge angle at all. Five widths, matching this family's plain stacked pair and stopping at 105.
